prompt: 检查这个项目的 PDF、图谱和导出适配器现在是否可用。
expected_route: Check Project-Wiki Runtime / P4.1 adapter readiness
must_not: call external providers or upload files
write adapter artifacts, binding files, source registry files, wiki files, backups, admin logs, graph outputs, or export outputs
checks: selects P4.1 adapter readiness / check_runtime route
uses contracts/adapter-status.schema.json as the response contract

summarizes configured adapters, attention items, warnings, next steps, and confirmation gates
does not treat missing adapters as permission to install or execute anything
